change_request: Final approved CR v2.4 (Fachbereich sign-off 15.09.2025): In the SAP HCM APP workflow ZHR1 (ZEHR_RM_HR1), introduce a dedicated Personalauswahl process step for business field 02 (Distribution) only, inserted after step 'Personalsuche starten' (1600/instance 1) and before 'Warteschritt Recruiting' (1600/instance 2). The existing Personalvorschlag tab must be hidden in all steps for Distribution and reused/renamed as the editable Personalauswahl tab in the new step (all other tabs read-only). The Auftraggeber (hiring manager), determined via field ANFRD using existing SAP agent-determination rules, captures candidate data, sets mandatory-document radio buttons on a Dokumente tab, uploads documents on the Kommentar/Anhang tab, and sends the workflow to Recruiting; a blocking warning must appear on send if documents may be missing. Captured data and attachments must be carried into the Warteschritt Recruiting step so Recruiting can start ZHR2 coverage; Recruiting needs an 'an AG / Abaenderung' button to return the workflow for corrections. An 'Ueberpruefung MA' duplicate-person check (name + date of birth + social-insurance fragment) must be added in the new step and also in ZHR2 step 2015. In step 1000 for Distribution only, add fields on the Bezahlung tab: Zustellart (mandatory multi-select PKW/zu Fuss/Fahrrad/Moped) and Fuehrerschein (mandatory, dynamically derived from Zustellart), both shown read-only later in Recruiting step 1600. The goal is to prevent a second ZHR1 being raised for the same demand so time-to-hire and open-position counts are measured correctly.
project_context: SAP HCM APP (ProcessBuilder) process optimization for the Distribution hiring flow, human-in-the-loop with mandatory approval and strict GDPR/data-protection controls. Affected systems: SAP HCM (PP2/KP2), ProcessBuilder (APP module), SAP authorizations; SuccessFactors and Recruiting remain out of scope for changes.
constraints: Scope is strictly limited to Distribution (business field 02, P9110-ZZGFELD = 02); all other org units and the standard ZHR1 process remain unchanged.
No changes to SuccessFactors functions or dashboards and no document upload by hiring managers in SuccessFactors.
Recruiting must remain the only role that starts ZHR2 coverage; hiring managers cannot start ZHR2 themselves.
No new authorization role is created; existing roles are reused and only the agent-determination rules are adjusted for the new step.
Must satisfy GDPR (DSGVO) and personal-data works-agreement requirements: exclude third-party access, restrict access to authorized persons only, and send notifications only to responsible persons.
Must-have requirements REQ-01..REQ-07 and REQ-16..REQ-19 are the release scope; should-have and nice-to-have items (REQ-08..REQ-15, REQ-20..REQ-24) are secondary.
Output and artifacts must not contain personal data.
affected_objects: SAP HCM APP workflow ZEHR_RM_HR1 (step 1600 instance 1 and instance 2)
New Personalauswahl process step and ANFRD-based agent determination
Personalvorschlag tab visibility logic (hidden for Distribution) and reuse as Personalauswahl tab
Dokumente tab with mandatory-document radio buttons and Kommentar/Anhang upload validation
Data and attachment handover into Warteschritt Recruiting plus 'an AG / Abaenderung' return loop
'Ueberpruefung MA' duplicate-person check in the new step and in ZHR2 step 2015
Step 1000 Bezahlung tab additions (Zustellart, Fuehrerschein) for Distribution
SAP agent-determination rules (e.g. rule 91000027 Recruiting, SFTYP recruiting responsibility) and authorization assignment
